episode_title: Interview with Sean Foley, Brand President of Redbox+ Dumpsters and Larry Oglesby, Franchisee of Redbox+ Dumpsters in Athens, Georgia

real_qa.q: What is the Redbox+ Dumpsters Elite Dumpster and what makes it unique in the waste management market?
real_qa.r: The Elite Dumpster is a patented product consisting of two portable toilets attached to the front of a 20- or 30-yard dumpster. When a contractor calls, they get two services with one call, and they always have a toilet on site that is cleaned at least every seven days. However, the real differentiator is customer service: Redbox+ guarantees that within 24 hours franchisees will either have a dumpster on site or will pick up, empty and return one if needed.
real_qa.requete: Redbox+ Dumpsters Elite Dumpster patented product

real_qa.q: How many franchise locations does Redbox+ Dumpsters currently operate and how many territories are available?
real_qa.r: Redbox+ Dumpsters has 76 locations right now, with approximately 220 territories open coast to coast from New York to Massachusetts all the way over to California and everywhere in between.

real_qa.q: What startup equipment requirements does Redbox+ Dumpsters recommend for new franchisees?
real_qa.r: Redbox+ recommends franchisees start with two trucks because if one truck goes down, operations are severely impacted. The company also recommends approximately 60 to 70 dumpsters at startup, with 42 being the minimum, but they advise starting with more to ensure franchisees have enough equipment for their first year to year and a half of operations.
real_qa.requete: Redbox+ Dumpsters startup requirements trucks dumpsters

real_qa.q: How quickly did Larry Oglesby reach break-even cash flow with his Redbox+ Dumpsters franchise in Athens, Georgia?
real_qa.r: Larry Oglesby reached break-even cash flow in month five, including paying back all loans and debt. He noted that for a capital-intensive B2B business, achieving cash flow break-even in five months would be considered successful, though the first few months were slower than anticipated before ramping up significantly in month four.
real_qa.requete: Larry Oglesby Redbox+ Dumpsters Athens Georgia break-even

real_qa.q: What is Kaizen and how does Sean Foley apply it to leading the Redbox+ Dumpsters brand?
real_qa.r: Kaizen is a concept of constant improvement. Sean Foley is a devotee to this philosophy and applies it to the Redbox+ brand by always pushing forward and improving rather than resting on current success. He invests continuously in maintenance programs, brings prospecting tools like Blue Book to franchisees at no additional cost, and has changed purchasing policies to allow franchisees to buy dumpsters from local fabricators so they can grow faster.

guest.bio_context: Sean Foley spent 12 years as a construction litigation attorney licensed in Maryland, D.C., and Pennsylvania. He then transitioned into franchising, operating a home care franchise business with his wife where they were named franchisees of the year in 2016 before selling in 2018. He served as a business coach for Comfort Care Home Care for two years and joined Belfort Franchise Group in 2022, becoming Brand President of Redbox+ Dumpsters in January 2024.
